scientific_limitations: Exact mathematical Pareto classification of mean passage and the leading asymptotic many-searcher arrival coefficient on a one-dimensional reflecting–absorbing interval at fixed spatial average diffusivity. No finite-N, noise-stability, multi-dimensional or non-Itô optimality claim. The stochastic claim for measurable diffusivities is confined to smooth uniformly positive profiles plus the explicit singular mean optimum; no independent external validation or publication-priority certification.
title: Exact mean–extreme first-passage Pareto frontier for budgeted diffusion
